Subsequent web browsing (Steps 7–9) did not fix the method or produce the correct count, so the mistake persisted uncorrected.

The code also fails to implement proper pagination using the 'continue/rvcontinue' mechanism; it merely checks if count == 500 without supplying or updating any continuation parameter, so it would at best retrieve a single batch and miscount. This is the first point where these mistakes are introduced, and later steps did not correct them (they doubled down on obtaining/using a token), satisfying all three criteria.

These choices were first introduced in Step 0 and persisted through later steps without correction.
